name: Donut Dongle gameID v0.8.4
body:
**MemCardPro**
- MemCardPro gameID detection now also supports **WebUI v2** mode.
   - Use a "gameID Consoles" Address of:
      - mcp://IP-ADDRESS for WebUI v2
      - http://IP-ADDRESS/api/currentState for Local WebUI
   
**Mobile layout**
- Settings and RT Diag collapsed by default for a cleaner look.
- IR Send Rules is now more friendly for mobile use.
- UI refinement

**Misc**
- **IR Send Rules** now supports 16bit addresses and bonus "tink off / on" commands.
- New **Wake RetroTink on detected Profile Change** option in Settings / "Profile Rules".
- ESP32 reboot / WebCtl reconnection process is more robust w/ faster load times and refreshes.
- Settings / Profiles page is always available even when the RetroTink is asleep.
- Fixed bugs related to:
  - table column resize.
  - Search not updating when a new file was created.

**Switch Arbitration rule change**
- When the last physical switch that was King turns Off and nothing else is active, S0 is allowed to take control regardless of RMTuse = 1
